## Random Logistics Map
Suppose we start with initial values $X_0=\frac{1}{2}$ and $X_0=\frac{1}{4}$. Then we get the following 
```{r}
n <- 10^5
# Paremeters for beta distribution
alpha <- 1 # alpha>1/2
a <- alpha+1/2
b <- alpha-1/2
U <- runif(n)
hist(qbeta(U,a,b))
```
```{r}
X0 <- 1/2
Y0 <- 1/8
curve(x*(1-x), from=0, to=1, , xlab=TeX("$B_1$"), ylab=TeX("$X_2=4B_2 B_1(1-B_1)$"))
```
```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
# curve(x*(1-x), from=0, to=1, xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n", xlab=TeX("$B_1$"), ylab=TeX("$X_2$"), main=TeX("$X_2=4 B_1(1-B_1)$"))
# axis(side=1, at=c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75, 1))
# axis(side=2, at=c(0,0.125, 0.25))
f_X1 <- function(x){
  y= ifelse(
    x <= 0.5,
    x * (1 - x),
    (x - 0.5) * (1 - (x - 0.5))
  )
  return(y)
}
```

# Generate equimeasurable mapping of X_2

```{r}
alpha <- 2
h <- function(u, xi, a, b, t) {
  stopifnot(length(u) == length(xi))
  
  y <- u  # default: unchanged
  
  inside <- (u > a) & (u < b)
  
  idx1 <- inside & (xi == 1)
  idx0 <- inside & (xi != 1)
  
  y[idx1] <- (u[idx1] - a) / (b - a) * (t - a) + a
  y[idx0] <- (u[idx0] - a) / (b - a) * (b - t) + t
  
  return(y)
}

g <- function(u, a, b) {
  y <- u                      # default: unchanged
  idx <- (u > a) & (u < b)    # elements inside (a,b)
  y[idx] <- a + b - u[idx]    # reflect inside (a,b)
  y
}

f_X2 <- function(B1,B2){
  return(4*B2*B1*(1-B1))
}

gen_X2 <- function(u,xi, B2,t){
  a <- 0
  b <- 1
  #t <- pbeta(0.5, 2.5, 1.5)
  B1 <- qbeta(g(h(u,xi,a,b,t),t,1),alpha + 0.5,alpha-0.5)
  X2 <- f_X2(B1,B2)
  return(X2)
}
```

```{r}
alpha <- 1
n <- 100000
# Creating X2, X22

t <- pbeta(0.5, alpha + 0.5,alpha-0.5)
u <- runif(n)
xi <- as.numeric(rbernoulli(n,t))
B2 <- rbeta(n, alpha + 0.5,alpha-0.5)
X2 <- gen_X2(u,xi,B2,t)


B1 <- rbeta(n, alpha + 0.5,alpha-0.5)
B2 <- rbeta(n, alpha + 0.5,alpha-0.5)
X22 <- f_X2(B1,B2)

# Creating Y22
B1 <- rbeta(n, alpha + 0.5,alpha-0.5)
B2 <- rbeta(n, alpha + 0.5,alpha-0.5)
Y22 <- f_Y2(B1,B2)
```

```{r}
plot_densities <- function(Y2, Y22,label1,label2) {
  d1 <- density(Y2,  from = 0, to = 1)
  d2 <- density(Y22, from = 0, to = 1)

  plot(
    d1,
    type = "n",
    xlab = expression(x),
    ylab = "Density",
    main = "",
    ylim = c(0, max(d1$y, d2$y))
  )

  polygon(
    c(d1$x, rev(d1$x)),
    c(d1$y, rep(0, length(d1$y))),
    col = rgb(0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 0.1),
    border = NA
  )

  polygon(
    c(d2$x, rev(d2$x)),
    c(d2$y, rep(0, length(d2$y))),
    col = rgb(0.1, 0.6, 0.3, 0.1),
    border = NA
  )

  lines(d1, lwd = 2, col = rgb(0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 0.9))
  lines(d2, lwd = 2, col = rgb(0.1, 0.6, 0.3, 0.9), lty = 2)

  legend(
    "topright",
    #legend = c(TeX("$Y''_2$"), TeX("$Y_2$")),
    legend = c(TeX(label1), TeX(label2)),
    fill = c(rgb(0.2,0.4,0.8,0.35),
             rgb(0.1,0.6,0.3,0.35)),
    border = NA,
    bty = "n"
  )
}
```

```{r}
n <- 50000
alpha_vals <- 1:10   # choose whatever grid you want

# storage
results <- data.frame(
  alpha = alpha_vals,
  CRN = NA,
  min   = NA
)

for (i in seq_along(alpha_vals)) {
  
  alpha <- alpha_vals[i]
  
  ## ---------- X22 and Y22 ----------
  B1 <- rbeta(n, alpha + 0.5, alpha - 0.5)
  B2 <- rbeta(n, alpha + 0.5, alpha - 0.5)
  
  X22 <- f_X2(B1, B2)
  Y22 <- f_Y2(B1, B2)
  
  results$CRN[i] <- mean(abs(X22 - Y22))
  
  ## ---------- X2 and Y2 ----------
  t_X <- pbeta(0.5, alpha + 0.5, alpha - 0.5)
  t_Y <- pbeta(2/3, alpha + 0.5, alpha - 0.5)
  
  u    <- runif(n)
  u_xi <- runif(n)
  B2   <- rbeta(n, alpha + 0.5, alpha - 0.5)
  B1   <- qbeta(u, alpha + 0.5, alpha - 0.5)
  
  xi_X <- ifelse(u_xi < t_X, 1, 0)
  xi <- as.numeric(rbernoulli(n,t_X))
  #xi_Y <- ifelse(u < t_Y, 1, 0)
  
  X2 <- gen_X2(u, xi_X, B2, t)
  #Y2 <- gen_Y2(u, xi_Y, B2, t)
  Y2 <- f_Y2(B1, B2)
  
  results$min[i] <- mean(abs(X2 - Y2))
}

results
```

```{r}
getExpDist_CRN <- function(n,alpha, X0,Y0){
  a <- alpha+1/2
  b <- alpha-1/2
  B1 <- rbeta(n, a,b)
  B2 <- rbeta(n, a,b)
  X <- 16*B2*B1*X0*(1-X0)*(1-4*B1*X0*(1-X0))
  Y <- 16*B2*B1*Y0*(1-Y0)*(1-4*B1*Y0*(1-Y0))
  mean((X-Y)^2)
}

getExpDist_min <- function(n,alpha, X0,Y0){
  a <- alpha+1/2
  b <- alpha-1/2
  
  a1 <- 1/(8*X0*(1-X0))
  a2 <- 1/(8*Y0*(1-Y0))
  li <- pbeta(min(a1,a2),a,b)
  ui <- pbeta(min(1,max(a1,a2)),a,b)
  li
  ui

  U <- runif(n,0,1)
  V <- U
  for(i in 1:length(U)){
    if ((li < U[i]) & (U[i] <ui)){
    V[i] <- li +(1-(U[i]-li)/(ui-li))*(ui-li)
    } else{
      V[i] <- U[i]
    } 
  }
  B1X <- qbeta(U,a,b)
  B1Y <- qbeta(V,a,b)
  
  B2 <- rbeta(n, a,b)
  X <- 16*B2*B1X*X0*(1-X0)*(1-4*B1X*X0*(1-X0))
  Y <- 16*B2*B1Y*Y0*(1-Y0)*(1-4*B1Y*Y0*(1-Y0))
  
  mean((X-Y)^2)
}
```

```{r}
minDiff <- 1:10
crnDiff <- 1:10
n <- 10^4
for(alpha in 1:10){
  crnDiff[alpha] <- getExpDist_CRN(n, alpha, X0,Y0)
  minDiff[alpha] <- getExpDist_min(n, alpha, X0,Y0)
}

df <- data.frame(alpha = 1:10,min = minDiff, CRN = crnDiff)
df
```

```{r}
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("CRN", "Tighter Wass bound"), values = c("blue", "red")) 
```

# Zeno's walk
```{r}
f_plus <- function(x){
  if(x <= -2){y=x+2}
  if(-2 <= x & x <= 0){y=x/2+1}
  if(0<=x){y=x+1}
  return(y)
}

f_minus <- function(x){
  if(x<=0){y=x-1}
  if(0<=x & x <=2){y=x/2-1}
  if(2<=x){y=x-2}
  return(y)
}
```

```{r}
n <- 100
X <- 1:n
Y <- 1:n
X[1] <- 0
Y[1] <- 100
for(i in 2:n){
  r <- 0.5
  B <- rbernoulli(1,r)
  X[i] <- B*f_plus(X[i-1])+(1-B)*f_minus(X[i-1])
  Y[i] <- B*f_plus(Y[i-1])+(1-B)*f_minus(Y[i-1])
}
```

```{r}
# Simulate CRN over 1000 iterations
n <- 1000 # no of simulations
m <- 500 # no of iterations
X <- 1:m
Y <- 1:m
X0 <- 0
Y0 <- 100
X[1] <- X0
Y[1] <- Y0
R <- c(0.1,0.33,0.5)
df <- data.frame(X=c(),Y=c(), it =c(), sim_no=c(), r=c())
for (r in R){
    for (j in 1:n){
    B <- rbernoulli(m,r)
    X[1] <- X0
    Y[1] <- Y0
    for (i in 2:m){
      X[i] <- B[i]*f_plus(X[i-1])+(1-B[i])*f_minus(X[i-1])
      Y[i] <- B[i]*f_plus(Y[i-1])+(1-B[i])*f_minus(Y[i-1])
    }
    df <- rbind(df, data.frame(X,Y, it = 1:m, sim_no=j, r))
  }
}

df
df %>%
  group_by(it) %>%
  summarise(mean(abs(X-Y)))
```

```{r}
f_plus <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    x >= 0, x + 1,
    ifelse(x >= -2, x/2 + 1, x + 2)
  )
}

f_minus <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    x <= 0, x - 1,
    ifelse(x <= 2, x/2 - 1, x - 2)
  )
}

```

```{r}
x <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 1000)

plot(
  x, f_plus(x),
  type = "l",
  lwd  = 2,
  col  = "black",
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  ylim = range(c(f_plus(x), f_minus(x)))
)

lines(
  x, f_minus(x),
  lwd = 2,
  lty = 2
)

abline(v = c(-2, 0, 2), lty = 3, col = "gray70")

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c(expression(f^"+(x)"), expression(f^"-(x)")),
  lwd    = 2,
  lty    = c(1, 2),
  bty    = "n"
)

points(c(-2, 0), f_plus(c(-2, 0)), pch = 16)
points(c(0, 2),  f_minus(c(0, 2)),  pch = 16)
```

# Dirichlet process 
```{r}
n <- 10
X <- 1:n
Y <- (1:n)+10

f_dirichlet <- function(x, b, a){
  return((1-b)*a+b*x)
}

for(i in 2:n){
  B <- rbeta(n,2,1)
  A <- rnorm(n)
  X[i] <- f_dirichlet(X[i-1],B[i], A[i])
  Y[i] <- f_dirichlet(Y[i-1],B[i], A[i])
}

plot(X-Y)
```
```{r}
one_run_crn <- function(n, a, b) {

  X <- numeric(n)
  Y <- numeric(n)

  X[1] <- 1
  Y[1] <- 110

  # U <- runif(n)
  # A <- rnorm(n)

  for (i in 2:n) {
    X[i] <- f_dirichlet(X[i-1], qbeta(U[i], a, b), A[i])
    Y[i] <- f_dirichlet(Y[i-1], qbeta(U[i], a, b), A[i])
  }

  abs(X - Y)
}

one_run_alt <- function(n, a, b) {

  X <- numeric(n)
  Y <- numeric(n)

  X[1] <- 1
  Y[1] <- 110

  # U <- runif(n)
  # A <- rnorm(n)

  for (i in 2:n) {

    u_x <- U[i] + (X[i-1] - A[i] < 0) * (1 - 2 * U[i])
    b_x <- qbeta(u_x, a, b)
    X[i] <- f_dirichlet(X[i-1], b_x, A[i])

    u_y <- U[i] + (Y[i-1] - A[i] < 0) * (1 - 2 * U[i])
    b_y <- qbeta(u_y, a, b)
    Y[i] <- f_dirichlet(Y[i-1], b_y, A[i])
  }
  abs(X - Y)
}

```

```{r}
n     <- 10
a     <- 2
b     <- 1
n_sim <- 1

diff_mat <- replicate(
  n_sim,
  one_run_alt(n, a, b)
)

mean_diff_alt <- rowMeans(diff_mat)

diff_mat <- replicate(
  n_sim,
  one_run_crn(n, a, b)
)

mean_diff_crn <- rowMeans(diff_mat)
```

```{r}
)

lines(mean_diff_crn, lty = 2, col="red")
```

# Non linear function
```{r}
simulate_crn_df <- function(M = 1000, n = 10, 
                            x0 = 0, y0 = 2,
                            sd_z = 1) {
  
  # Storage
  X <- matrix(0, nrow = M, ncol = n + 1)
  Y <- matrix(0, nrow = M, ncol = n + 1)
  
  # Initial values
  X[, 1] <- x0
  Y[, 1] <- y0
  
  # Iterate
  for (k in 1:n) {
    
    # Common random numbers
    Z <- rnorm(M, mean = 0, sd = sd_z)
    
    # Updates
    X[, k + 1] <- (sin(X[, k])) + Z
    Y[, k + 1] <- (sin(Y[, k])) + Z
  }
  
  # Convert to tidy data frame
  df <- data.frame(
    chain = rep(1:M, each = n + 1),
    iteration = rep(0:n, times = M),
    X = as.vector(t(X)),
    Y = as.vector(t(Y))
  )
  
  df$abs_diff <- abs(df$X - df$Y)
  
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}

df_sim <- simulate_crn_df(M = 1000, n = 10000, x0 = 0, y0 = 3, sd_z = 1)
```
